content:
Apple TV subscribers can now stream the first episode of the new season of Women in Blue (Las Azules). Here’s what to expect from the season.

Las Azules are back

A few days ago, Apple TV published the trailer for the new season of Women in Blue, its Spanish-language crime drama, which in its first season told the story of “four women who defy the ultraconservative norms of the time and join Mexico’s first female police force, only to discover that their squad is a publicity stunt to distract the media from a brutal serial killer.”

The show’s first season premiered in 2024 and ran for 10 episodes, most of which are rated 8.0 or higher on IMDb. For its second season, Women in Blue will run for 8 episodes every Wednesday through September 30.
